_about: Frozen evaluation set for the experiments (Stage 7; PDF 2.3 'log your experiments and compare', 2.5). Built from A3's knowledge_checks.json and router_cases.json plus the Stage 4-6 live cases. Do NOT edit once experiments have started: every result row records this file's hash. Fields: required = groups of tools, each group satisfied by calling at least one of them; allowed = extra tools that are fine; forbidden = tools that must not be called; no_tools = no tool may be called; must_include / must_not = case-insensitive regexes on the final answer; tool_args = regexes on the arguments of a call; forbid_saved_lead = no lead may be saved (OK from record_customer_interest). core = the 12-case subset for the sweeps.
